node.statement: By (A_2), ||D_{A^perp}f_V-I||<1, so the Neumann-series criterion makes every such derivative invertible; lem-stage1-smooth-unitary-atlas therefore makes the same g_V and chi_V smooth with unchanged points and first derivatives. Since (A_4) is a C^1 diffeomorphism, Pi_delta_* is a C^1 local diffeomorphism and its image S_delta_* is open; lem-stage1-smooth-polar-inverse makes this same Pi_delta_* and the same inverse (u_delta,h_delta) smooth. Global definition in (A_5) implies U bold-dot V and U^dagger belong to S_delta_*; hence lem-stage1-explicit-smooth-unitary-operations makes the same scalar action, mu, and sigma smooth, with unchanged values/differentials and sigma(cU)=conj(c)*sigma(U).
